description: This file contains classes and functions for importing datasets and datasources in Apache Superset, including YAML validation, database lookups, and data import logic.

classes.name: ImportDatasetsCommand
classes.description: Class for importing datasets in YAML format into Superset, with validation and execution logic.

methods.name: lookup_sqla_table
methods.description: Finds a SqlaTable in the database matching the given table's name, schema, and database ID.

methods.name: lookup_sqla_database
methods.description: Retrieves a Database object based on the database name in the table's parameters.

methods.name: import_dataset
methods.description: Imports a datasource object into the database, overriding existing metrics and columns.

methods.name: lookup_sqla_metric
methods.description: Finds a SqlMetric in the database matching the given metric's name and table ID.

methods.name: import_metric
methods.description: Imports a SqlMetric object, updating or creating as needed.

methods.name: lookup_sqla_column
methods.description: Finds a TableColumn in the database matching the given column's name and table ID.

methods.name: import_column
methods.description: Imports a TableColumn object, updating or creating as needed.

methods.name: import_datasource
methods.description: Imports a datasource, overriding existing data, and handles associated metrics and columns.

methods.name: import_simple_obj
methods.description: Imports a simple model object, updating if it exists, or creating a new one.

methods.name: import_from_dict
methods.description: Imports database configurations from a dictionary structure.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the YAML contents to ensure proper format and keys.
